slides.text: Glance Pay for Even Realities G2. No camera, no speaker — text in the lens and a ring. Tap to begin.
Say an amount. Raw microphone PCM goes through speech to text and a parser becomes twelve rupees fifty.
Location and a seeded merchant registry pick the vendor. Scroll the ring to choose, then tap to confirm. No auto-pay.
Confirm shows merchant, rupees and U S D C on one glanceable line. One tap signs a fresh quote.
Our backend signs a real test USDC transfer on Ethereum Sepolia and waits for the on-chain receipt.
The backend verifies the transaction and emails the receipt via Resend. Testnet only — no real money moved.
The phone shows the verified tx hash, block and receipt email id. Every payment is auditable end to end.
Glance Pay: hands-free payments on G2, real on-chain settlement. We would love your feedback. Thank you.
